characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text:
**Combat Drills**: In step 3 of the Aftermath sequence you can pick up to 3 friendly *Henchmen* to train. Each of those fighters earns d6 bonus experience.
**Eager to Prove**: In step 6 of the Aftermath sequence, roll a dice. On a 6, a Guild Recruit arrives at the Guild Barracks. You can recruit a Guild Recruit to your warband for 0 silver.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text:
**Vintage Wines**: When this holding is first added to a warband roster, it has 2d6 bottles of **vintage wine**. Make a note on your warband roster.
Each time you collect income from this holding, after rolling the dice, you can choose to sell a bottle of vintage wine. If you do so, reduce the count by 1 and re-roll the dice. You must accept the second result.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: **Atonement for Sin**: If your warband lost the battle, in step 3 of the Aftermath sequence, make a Willpower test for each *Witch Hunter* and *Priest* in your warband. If they pass, they earn 5 bonus experience.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: **Sorcerous Study**: Each battle, before you determine prepared spells, you can pick 1 friendly *Wizard* in your warband. Instead of randomly determining the spell they have prepared from a Spell Lore, you can pick.

rules.name: Veteran of the City
rules.description: When this fighter is recruited, pick 2 skills for them.

rules.name: Master of Spellcraft
rules.description: This fighter knows the *Lore of Sanctioned Magic*. When they are recruited, pick 2 spells from it to be their signature spells. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

rules.name: Guild Magic
rules.description: This fighter knows the **Lore of Sanctioned Magic**. When they are recruited, pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

rules.name: Hole Magic
rules.description: This fighter knows the **Lore of the Saints**. When they are recruited, pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

rules.name: Patch You Up [Action]
rules.description:
As an action, make a Willpower test for this fighter. If failed, the action
ends. If passed, pick a friendly fighter within 1" of them. That fighter heals 1 life point.

rules.name: Sawbones
rules.description: Once in each aftermath sequence, if this fighter was not taken down during battle, they can oversee the recovery of another fighter. Pick a friendly fighter that was taken down. When rolling on the lasting injury table for that fighter, you can roll twice and pick either result.

rules.name: Trackers
rules.description: Each aftermath sequence, when you search the city. If your search party includes any Hunting Dogs, you can re-roll the exploration roll.

sharedRules.name: Recite Holy Litanies [Action]
sharedRules.description: Once per battle, this fighter can make this action. If they do so, pick a visible enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter to be the target, that target must be a *Wizard*, *Priest*, *Demon* or *Undead*. Roll a dice for this fighter and add its Willpower value to the result. The commanding player of the target does the same for their fighter. If the result for this fighter is equal or higher than the result for the target, the target suffers d3 damage.

rules.name: Bomb-bolt
rules.description:
This item requires the fighter to be equipped with a Crossbow.
Once per battle, when this fighter can make a Ranged Attack action with the following weapon:
|Range|Attacks|Rend|Damage|Critical Damage|Weapon Traits|
|---|---|---|---|---|:--|
|20"|1|-1|d3+1|-|*Blast*|

rules.name: Ogre Armour
rules.description: *Armour value 5+*

rules.name: Guild Banner
rules.description:
While this fighter is on the battlefield, you can re-roll flee tests.
You can re-roll Willpower tests made by friendly fighters while they are within 12" of this fighter and this fighter is visible to them.

rules.name: Loyal Companion
rules.description:
Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, they can make 1 additional attack with the following weapon:
|Rend|Damage|Critical Damage|Weapon Traits|
|---|---|---|:--|
|-1|1|d3|Natural Weapon|

rules.name: Torchlight/Lantern
rules.description: Worsen the Armour value of enemy *Demon* and *Undead* fighters by 1 while they are engaged with any fighters equipped with this item.

rules.name: Wooden Stakes
rules.description:
Once per battle, while this fighter is engaged in melee with a *Undead* or *Demon* fighter that is bloodied, it can use the following bonus action:
**Drive the Stake [Bonus Action]**: Pick an enemy *Demon* or *Undead* fighter this fighter is engaged in melee with, that is bloodied, to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+ the target is immediately taken down. In the aftermath of battle, this fighter earns 10 bonus experience.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Pick the closest visible enemy fighter within 15" of the caster to be the target. That fighter is hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3|

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Pick a visible friendly fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target, then pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons to be *ignited* until the end of the round. While a weapon is *ignited*:
- It gains the *Arcane* Weapon Trait.
- Improve it’s Rend characteristic by 1.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Pick 2 visible points on a platform or the battlefield floor, each within 9" of the caster, 6" of each other and the same elevation. A barrier is drawn between these two points.
The barrier remains in play until the end of the round or the caster is taken down. While the barrier is in play:
- Subtract 1 from attack rolls for ranged attacks made that cross the barrier.
- Fighters that are activated in the barrier or move across the barrier suffer d3 damage.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: The 2 points can be set up within 9" of each other instead of 6".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible enemy *Wizard* or *Priest* within 12" to be the target. Until the end of the round, that fighter cannot make arcane actions.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the flame template. Each fighter in its area is targeted and hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3+1|

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a visible point within 15" of the caster, it then scatters d6".
Each fighter in its area is hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3+1|

After the attacks have been resolved, the blast template remains where it is. It represents a vortex that remains
in play until the end of the round.
Line of sight cannot be drawn across the vortex for fighters on the same elevation. In addition, fighters who start their activation within the vortex, or move across it, are hit with the same attack.
At the end of the round, remove the vortex.

rules.name: Trained Duellist
rules.description: When this fighter is recruited, they already have the Duellist skill. In addition, pick 1 skill for them.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 15" of the caster to be the target. Heal d3 life points to the target.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Heal 3 life points instead of d3.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 9" of the caster to have *blessed blades* until the end of the round. While a fighter has *blessed blades*, add 1 to hit rolls for melee attacks made by them.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: If critically cast, up to 2 friendly fighters can be picked instead of 1.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Until the end of the round, the caster has a 9" aura of *godspeed*. Friendly fighters who begin a move while they are within the aura add 1" to the maximum distance they can move.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the aura from 9" to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 15" of the caster. That fighter has the *Will of the Saints* until the end of the round. While a fighter has the *Will of the Saints*, improve their Armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. (For example, 6+ becomes 5+).

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: If critically cast, up to 2 friendly fighters can be picked instead of 1.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Until the end of the round, the caster has a 6" aura of *holy strength*. Add 1 to the Critical Damage values of melee weapons used by friendly fighters while they are within the aura.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text:
Increase the range of the aura
from 6" to 9".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Pick a visible point on the battlefield floor within 12" of the caster. While a friendly fighter is within 3" of that point, their armour value is improved by 1.
The spell remains in play. While this spell is in play, the caster must pass a Willpower test at the start of their activation, else the spell ends. If they attempt to cast this spell again while it is still in play, the first instance of it ends (even if they fail to cast it again).
If the caster is taken down, the spell ends.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: While the spell is in play, friendly fighters are affected while they are within 6" of that point, instead of 3".

rules.name: Rallying Cry
rules.description:
Once per battle, this fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Rallying Cry [Bonus Action]**: This fighter heals 1 damage. In addition, at the end of the round, if this fighter is still on the battlefield, the commanding player does not need to take a Flee test for their warband.

rules.name: Point Blank Shot
rules.description: While this fighter is engaged in melee, they can attempt to make Ranged Attack action. To do so, they take an Initiative test. If passed they can make a Ranged Attack action but cannot use a *Heavy* weapon. The Ranged Attack actionmust target a fighter they are engaged in melee with. If failed, the action immediately ends.

rules.name: Crackshot
rules.description: When making a ranged attack action, this fighter scores a critical hit on a natural roll of a 5 or a 6.

rules.name: Feint
rules.description: Once per melee attack action, after an enemy has successfully parried one of this fighter’s hits, this fighter can attempt a feint. To do so, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the parry roll, the hit is not parried and it becomes a critical hit.

rules.name: Explorer’s Instincts
rules.description: If this fighter is picked to lead a search party, you can re-roll one of the dice in the exploration roll (either the ‘tens’ or the ‘units’).

rules.name: Right On Time
rules.description: You can re-roll reinforcement rolls made for a battle group that includes this fighter.

rules.name: Blackpowder Specialist
rules.description: You can re-roll misfire rolls made for this fighter.

rules.name: Shield Expert
rules.description: If this fighter is equipped with a shield, improve their Armour value by an additional 1 (to a maximum of 2+), while they are the defending fighter and the attacking fighter made a Charge move this activation.

rules.name: Marksman
rules.description: Add 3" to the Range value of this fighter's ranged weapons (excluding those with the *Flame* weapon trait).

rules.name: Fight Till the End
rules.description: While this fighter is bloodied, add 1 to the Damage and Critical Damage value of their melee weapons.

rules.name: Blessed by the Saints
rules.description: Each round, the first time this fighter is hit by an attack that is a critical hit, the attack is not a critical hit.

rules.name: Stand Ground
rules.description: Once per battle, at the start of a melee attack action in which this fighter is the defending fighter and the attacking fighter charged in the same activation, this fighter can *stand their ground*. If they do so, their melee weapons gain the *Brace* and *Bludgeon* weapon traits until the end of the activation
